bootstrap.interval_interpretation: technical mask-plus-Rademacher-trace-probe variability only; not biological, patient, or training-seed uncertainty
bootstrap.resampling: sample 3 masks with replacement, then independently sample 32 probes with replacement within each selected mask

controls.identical: current-width seed0 checkpoint loaded into two independent instances with every VJP recomputed

randomized.paired_rng_prefix_limitation: draws can share an RNG prefix where unequal-width parameter shapes align; this can raise randomized-control similarity and makes required separation conservative
randomized.pairing: current and wider models separately instantiated with the same listed paired seed

estimand: local model-implied relaxed categorical sensitivity, including direct and two-layer multihop paths

input.coordinates: four observed relaxed one-hot token channels
input.projection: subtract the four-channel gradient mean independently for every node and gene

maximum_claim: paired local functional similarity of trained models on one transductive core; not a causal effect or biological mechanism

output.centering: subtract the four-class mean logit independently for every masked receiver and gene

sufficient_statistics.aggregation: equal-weight mean of A2/B2/AB over 32 probes within each mask, then equal-weight mean over the 3 masks
